capabilities: : Jump to top or bottom of a note
extras: Session-only navigation; local operation; manual installation required.
intentEvidence: Read and Return adds temporary return points and position history to long Markdown notes in Obsidian.
problem: It is difficult to navigate and return to a specific reading spot within a very long note without manually searching for it.
summary: Adds temporary return points and navigation history to long Markdown notes, allowing users to jump to specific sections and return to their original reading position.
